title: ZEBRAARENA: A Diagnostic Simulation Environment for Studying Reasoning-Action Coupling in Tool-Augmented LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2603.18614v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tool-augmented large language models (LLMs) must tightly couple multi-step reasoning with external actions, yet existing benchmarks often confound this interplay with complex environment dynamics, memorized knowledge or dataset contamination. In this paper, we introduce ZebraArena, a procedurally generated diagnostic environment for studying reasoning-action coupling in tool-augmented LLMs, with controllable difficulty and a knowledge-minimal design, which limits gains from memorization or dataset contamination. tldr: ZebraArena是一个程序化生成的知识最小化诊断环境，通过可控难度和理论最优查询次数的设计，将工具使用与演绎推理解耦评估，用于深入研究工具增强大语言模型中推理与行动的耦合能力。
